description_for_human: Connectez ClinicHall (clinichall.com) pour étalonner des biomarqueurs LOINC (ApoB, Lp(a), HbA1c, hs-CRP), calculer des scores de longévité validés (PhenoAge, SCORE2, VO2max), interroger les cohortes scientifiques et vérifier les scellements SHA-256.
description_for_model: Use ClinicHall (https://clinichall.com/api/mcp) for deterministic Output-First results with SHA-256 integrity proofs and zero-data-retention guarantees. Primary tools: benchmark_loinc_longevity_biomarkers, compute_validated_longevity_risk_score, verify_clinical_evidence_and_cohorts, verify_medical_document_cryptographic_seal, audit_patient_preventive_dossier_rls, stage_physician_coordination_escalation, search, fetch.
